head_commit.message:
fix(deps): bump fastapi >=0.121 and pin starlette >=0.49.1 (CVE-2025-62727)

Trivy flagged starlette 0.41.3 (transitive via fastapi 0.115.x) as HIGH —
CVE-2025-62727. fastapi <0.121 caps starlette at <0.42, so the fix is to
bump fastapi past that cap and add an explicit starlette floor so future
resolvers can't slip back below the patched version.

Verified locally: rebuilt images ship starlette 0.49.3 / fastapi 0.136.1,
both services boot, full J1->J2 sensor + SOS pipeline still passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
fix(j2): skip alembic upgrade on startup, drop local postgres dep

J2 reads/writes Supabase (managed via SQL files, no alembic_version
table). Running `alembic upgrade head` from the entrypoint crashed the
container by attempting to apply migrations against the live schema.

Override the command to run uvicorn directly and remove the postgres
service_healthy dependency since J2 does not use the local Postgres.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(j1): add Dockerfile and fix docker-compose for containerised dev

- Restore missing backend/Dockerfile (multi-stage Python build with librdkafka)
- Rewrite j1-device-edge/docker-compose.yml: remove broken mosquitto
  reference, load MQTT creds from root .env, use disaster-net external network
- Root docker-compose.yml: pin network name to disaster-net to prevent
  folder-prefix issue when J1 compose joins it
- Remove DOCKER_NOTES.md (planning note, now implemented)
